en: Yo, challenger! Bugsy's Bug types are tough, but Fire and Flying moves will scorch and blow them away.
Ride the Spinarak carts across the webs to reach him. Step onto a cart's dock and off you go!
Bugsy's off looking into the Slowpoke Well. Something's wrong in town, and he can't sit still till it's sorted.
You beat Bugsy! Those bugs didn't stand a chance. On to Goldenrod City, champ!
